expected_structural_delta: No new modules, owners, policy, APIs or dependencies; two existing shell call sites and focused shell regression cases, under 20 production lines.
minimum_design: Continue past rebalance errors in existing autoscale and explicit Start paths, retaining charged owners and all per-start broker gates.
outcome: Independent native builders retry authoritative admission even when another owner cannot be recovered.

reuse_decisions.name: Native shared admission and fenced owner recovery
reuse_decisions.rationale: Rebalance errors retain unknown allocations; existing gated start remains the authority for every independent container.
